fusions.name: Thousand-Mile Descent
fusions.desc: Brings the migration down on one enemy up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you run between uses, up to 40% more.

fusions.name: Hopper Band
fusions.desc: A marching band of wingless hoppers tramples every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you, dealing 8 damage. Holds up to 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 20 seconds. For 5 seconds after you use it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Miles Become Mouths
fusions.desc: After you cover ground, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
